name: Pride — Lamp Runner

primary.label: Claw Walk errands
primary.scope: Recognise protected stalls, carry word between merchants, and calm a queue at the shutters.

cue: A stallholder has paid for protection, but someone keeps taking their amber lamp. The runner asks who was on the corridor last shift.

name: Pride — Market Collector

primary.label: Market collections
primary.scope: Settle fee disputes, read a trader's mood, and enforce bargains under Pride protection.

secondary.label: Pit fighting
secondary.scope: Grapple or use implanted claws in a close bout.

cue: Two collectors have signed for the same payment. This one wants the crew to witness the count before the stallholder is charged twice.

name: Pride — Pit Second

primary.label: Pit fighting
primary.scope: Fight at arm's length, assess a challenger, or train a prospect for a bout.

secondary.label: Pride protocol
secondary.scope: Arrange a challenge or read the standing of a crew inside the Lion's Den.

cue: A prospect's claw jammed during rehearsal. The second offers the crew a ringside introduction if they get the prospect seen at Golden Hide before the bout.

name: Deck Nine Compact — Lift Hand

primary.label: Freight handling
primary.scope: Balance a load, read its restraints, and work the queue at Freight Lift Four.

cue: The next load is bound for the communal kitchen at Red Hall, but its booking has vanished. The lift hand has ten minutes to find it another slot.

name: Deck Nine Compact — Cargo Steward

primary.label: Dockside bargaining
primary.scope: Allocate freight space, settle handling fees, or find a willing crew for an unofficial load.

secondary.label: Lift work
secondary.scope: Direct a loading gang or spot a badly secured crate.

cue: A captain wants to jump the freight queue. The steward will hear the bid in Red Hall, where the displaced shift can answer for itself.

name: Deck Nine Compact — Air Crew Foreman

primary.label: Station life support
primary.scope: Find a failing air circuit, organise a repair, and keep a residential deck supplied.

secondary.label: Shift representation
secondary.scope: Hear a safety complaint, negotiate cover, or assemble a relief shift in Red Hall.

cue: The foreman needs a scrubber hauled to the Breathing Room and offers to clear a freight slot in exchange. A resident will guide the delivery.

name: Quiet Relay — Concourse Spotter

primary.label: Concourse observation
primary.scope: Recognise a contact, read a crowd, or remember who passed a public kiosk.

cue: A regular at Echo Rack 9 missed their usual stop. The spotter offers a small fee for someone to check the infirmaries.

name: Quiet Relay — Identity Broker

primary.label: Identity brokerage
primary.scope: Appraise a station credential, judge a claimant's story, and price an introduction.

secondary.label: Client interviews
secondary.scope: Read the room or put an anxious visitor at ease during a private meeting.

cue: Two clients have brought the broker the same name, and both claim it belongs to them. The broker wants a witness who knew either one before Affinity.

name: Quiet Relay — Contact Coordinator

primary.label: Source handling
primary.scope: Weigh conflicting reports, assess an informant, or negotiate the terms of a discreet introduction.

secondary.label: Station signals
secondary.scope: Interpret a relay fault, recognise a familiar feed, or judge the quality of a recording.

cue: The coordinator offers to arrange a call with a missing dockhand. First the caller must give a reason the dockhand would want to pick up.

name: Chorus — Stage Hand

primary.label: Live show support
primary.scope: Work a sound check, catch a performer's cue, or move a set through Resonance Alley on time.

cue: The opening act is locked out of rehearsal. The stage hand has a spare channel and needs someone the venue manager will recognise.

name: Chorus — Floor Marshal

primary.label: Club security
primary.scope: Spot trouble in a crowd, coordinate door staff, and escort patrons out of a packed venue.

secondary.label: Show timing
secondary.scope: Follow live cues and keep a performance on schedule.

cue: Two rivals arrive midway through a scheduled show in Resonance Alley. The marshal asks the crew to walk one outside before either breaks the peace.

name: Chorus — Memory Appraiser

primary.label: Sensory production
primary.scope: Evaluate a recording, recognise edits, and prepare a sensory session for buyers.

secondary.label: Nightlife brokerage
secondary.scope: Find a private buyer or read the mood of an auction at the Green Room.

cue: A buyer recognises a voice in a memory on offer. The appraiser pauses the preview and asks the crew to bring the original performer across from Cathedral 88.

name: Outboarder — Berth Runner

primary.label: Dockside errands
primary.scope: Recognise scrap buyers, carry tagged parts, or find the right crew at the cargo spine.

cue: At the Airlock Bar a suit patch has fallen from the memorial. The runner is waiting for a crewmate who knew its owner to pin it back.

name: Outboarder — Hull Hand

primary.label: EVA salvage
primary.scope: Work in a tether team, identify salvageable fittings, and bring loose components back to the lock.

secondary.label: Chop dock appraisal
secondary.scope: Identify a ship component or find a buyer for it at Blackbox Market.

cue: A launch due for stripping at Dead Berth 12 still has a family locker aboard. The hull hand wants someone landside to find the owners.

name: Outboarder — Walk Chief

primary.label: Exterior crew operations
primary.scope: Plan a hull walk, direct a salvage crew, or bring a stranded suit back to an airlock.

secondary.label: Suit maintenance
secondary.scope: Inspect a seal, assess damage to a suit, or organise a pressure test.

cue: A first-time walker calls off a job when a suit light comes on. The chief backs the call and needs a pilot to explain the delay to the berthmaster.

name: Ward Seven — Clinic Apprentice

primary.label: Clinic intake
primary.scope: Give basic trauma care, recognise an urgent arrival, and relay the triage team's requests.

cue: A patient at Mercy Blue has nobody to mind the battered case they brought in. The apprentice asks a familiar face to sit with it.

name: Ward Seven — Field Medic

primary.label: Emergency care
primary.scope: Assess casualties, provide trauma care, and move a patient through cramped service passages.

secondary.label: Clinic Row contacts
secondary.scope: Locate a quiet bed, a carrier, or someone willing to honour a medical favour.

cue: A patient wants to pay with a favour. The medic asks the crew to witness the terms while the patient is still awake and able to object.

name: Ward Seven — Recovery Escort

primary.label: Medical escort
primary.scope: Protect a patient or courier, negotiate a handover, and keep a medical team together in a crowd.

secondary.label: Field trauma care
secondary.scope: Assess casualties, assist a medic, or keep a patient stable in transit.

cue: A debtor offers to meet on Halo Steps. The escort leaves their sidearm at Mercy Blue and asks a traveller to witness the bargain on neutral ground.
